details: Bitcoin saw a 2% rise, briefly touching $62,000, after weaker-than-expected US nonfarm payrolls data for June eased concerns about potential Federal Reserve interest rate hikes. The US added only 57,000 jobs in June, significantly below forecasts. This macroeconomic data often influences risk assets, including cryptocurrencies, with a dovish Fed outlook generally seen as positive for crypto.
title: Weak US Jobs Data Boosts Bitcoin, Eases Rate Hike Fears

details: Iran has reportedly ruled out talks with US envoys ahead of Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei's funeral, intensifying geopolitical uncertainty. This development comes as the US has previously frozen Iran-linked crypto assets worth $344 million, and ongoing US-Iran negotiations have been noted as a factor weighing on crypto market sentiment. The rejection of talks could signal prolonged tensions.
title: Iran Rejects US Talks Ahead of Khamenei Funeral, Heightening Geopolitical Uncertainty

details: UK politician Nigel Farage has been reported to a standards watchdog over alleged "crypto lobbying" activities. This follows a significant backlash regarding a £5 million personal gift from a Thailand-based British crypto billionaire. Concurrently, a Bitcoin firm advertised by Farage experienced a 15% loss in its asset value. The scrutiny highlights growing concerns about political influence and transparency within the cryptocurrency space in the UK.
title: Nigel Farage Reported for Crypto Lobbying; Associated Bitcoin Firm's Value Dips

details: Argentine President Javier Milei is facing criticism from financial authorities and the public for promoting a "boom and bust" crypto scheme named $LIBRA. The scheme saw a significant price spike after his social media endorsement, only to collapse shortly thereafter. Milei, a known proponent of crypto, has denied any wrongdoing, stating his post was made in good faith. This incident raises questions about the influence of political figures on volatile crypto markets and investor protection in emerging crypto economies.
title: Argentina's President Milei Under Fire for Promoting Crypto Scheme
